title: Londerzeel Halifax Memorial
memorial_details: Marble tablet on the external wall of the church at Londerzeel, Vlaams-Brabant.
narrative: Halifax LK883 of 426 (RCAF) Squadron, coded OW-E, departed Linton-on-Ouse at 2207 on 12 May 1944 for Leuven. The aircraft was intercepted at 2200m, 8km west of Mechelen, by Oberleutnant Hans-Heinz Augenstein of 12/NJG1 and shot down at 0025 on 13 May, his 29th claim. Four crew were killed; three evaded capture; one became a prisoner of war.
cause_of_loss: Shot down by night fighter — Oblt Hans-Heinz Augenstein (12/NJG1), his 29th claim
